headline: Certification of 2026 State Election Results, plus an update on the District 1 City Council Special Election.
summary: A review of UOCAVA ballots received after Election Day may be taken up, if needed. The agenda also includes a review of the 2026 State Election and the election of officers.
items: Review of UOCAVA ballots received after Election Day, if needed
District 1 City Council Special Election Update
location: Elections Department Conference Room, Lowell City Hall, 375 Merrimack Street, Lowell MA 01852
plain_text:
Election Commission Meeting 
Tuesday, November 17, 2026 
Elections Department Conference Room, Lowell City Hall 
5:30 – 6:30 p.m. 
Public Participation 
Members of the public who wish to speak about a specific agenda item must register to speak in advance of the 
meeting by sending an email to the City of Lowell Elections and Census Office showing the agenda item. The 
email address is elections@lowellma.gov. If you do not have access to email, you may contact the office at 
(978) 674-4046. 
Agenda 
1. Minutes 
a. Approval of the old minutes of October 13 
2. New Business 
a. Review of UOCAVA Ballots received after Election Day (if needed) 
b. 2026 State Election Review 
c. Certification of 2026 State Election Results 
d. District 1 City Council Special Election Update 
e. Election of Officers
